summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting across login  ### What I found from reading the code (no changes made)  I audited the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/auth` / `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.  Contrary to the ticket's working theory, **everything I can see statically is wired correctly**: - Every watchlist route (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`) has its own auth middleware that requires a valid `arca_session` cookie, rejects with 401 if missing/expired, and scopes every query by `watchlists.user_id`. - `client/
